Name: Fashion Sense Simple Hand Mirror Retexture
Author: earthtosyd
Description:
✦ ABOUT

﻿﻿Replaces the Hand Mirror from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] in a style inspired by birDfiShi and mrtaiyou, intended to be used with the following mods:

﻿﻿﻿• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/birDfiSHi/mods]DSHi Rextexture[/url], or
﻿﻿ ﻿ ﻿• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou/mods]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]

✦ INSTALLATION

﻿﻿1. Download Fashion Sense Simple Hand Mirror Retexture from the FILES tab,

﻿﻿2. Extract the downloaded .zip file into the mod's folder, following the path:

﻿ ﻿﻿﻿C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

﻿﻿﻿﻿3. Done!
[color=#ff0000]
﻿NOTE: The following mod is made using Content Patcher and does not require manual file replacement.[/color]

✦ FEATURES

﻿﻿With the 2.1.0 update, the following configuration has been added:

﻿Mirror Style
﻿Change the hand mirror's style, ﻿available as round, simple, or vintage.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JWcgPC5.png[/img]
﻿﻿Wood Color
﻿Change the hand mirror's wood color, ﻿available in beige, black, brown, green, light brown, orange, pink, purple, red, or white.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/B7EZY9P.png[/img]
﻿﻿Floral Decoration
﻿﻿Optionally add floral decoration to the mirror's frame, available in blue, green, orange, pink, purple, red, white, yellow, or multicolored.
﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/d9ZjaM7.png[/img]
✦ FEEDBACK & SUGGESTIONS

﻿﻿If you have any ideas for additions and improvements, don’t hesitate to drop a comment and share your thoughts!

✦ RECOMMENDED

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/birDfiSHi/mods] ﻿﻿birDfiShi Retexture Collection
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou/mods] ﻿mrtaiyou Vanilla Tweaks Collection[/url]
